thesis: Negative FCF and debt far above equity make funding the decisive issue. Cloud demand validates spending opportunity but does not establish funded shareholder returns.
strongest_counterexample: Triple-digit cloud-infrastructure growth on an established profitable base could generate strong future monetization.
invalidation_conditions: Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of positive FCF.
Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if dated disclosed cash and committed facilities cover the next twelve months of debt maturities and committed capex.
evidence_gaps: Debt maturities, interest cover and contracted capacity cash returns.
Underlying statement periods and forward-estimate dates are not fully supplied.
decisive_factors: Cloud growth and established operating income support demand
Triple-digit cloud growth supports the demand premise, but does not settle the funding premise
